A new library opens downtown

The new library on Main Street opened its doors on Saturday morning, with a line of families stretching around the block before the ribbon was cut by the mayor.

The building has three floors, a cafe and a room for teenagers with computers and a small recording studio that anyone with a library card can book for free.

This story was originally published on November 3, 2026 and has been updated with comments from the mayor.
